New NOAA NGOFS2 MODEL guidance is about +59/+158/+115/+58 m at 1/3/6/12 hours: still shoreward across every window, stronger at 1/3 hours but weaker at 6/12 hours. Production opportunity decreased to Point Clear 2-5% and Daphne/May Day 1-3%, below 20%. Direct Grand Hotel and Fairhope players advanced at 20:38-20:39 CDT; strong flag motion was visible at Grand Hotel, while darkness left biology largely UNKNOWN. Direct local bottom oxygen remains UNKNOWN. The alert gate is met for camera recovery and the active thunderstorm/mixing change, not Jubilee evidence.
